description: Goose via its native ACP subcommand. Subscription access stays in your Goose login; Garuda never reads it.
warnings: Vendor capability mediation is negotiated at handshake; strict garuda-only policies may be refused — review before mutating runs.
setup: 1. Install the Goose CLI and log in. 2. Verify: goose --version. Garuda never reads your Goose credentials.
